title.english: Umama bint Qurt ibn Khansa ibn Sinan ibn Ubayd ibn Adi ibn Ghanm ibn Ka'b ibn Salima, the Ansari woman of Banu Salima

segments.arabic:
١٠٨٣٢- أمامة بنت قرط
بن خنساء بن سنان بن عبيد بن عدي بن غنم بن كعب بن سلمة الأنصارية السلمية.
قال ابن سعد: هي زوج يزيد بن قيظي، وكان من رهطها، وأسلمت وبايعت.
segments.english:
10832—Umama bint Qurt ibn Khansa ibn Sinan ibn Ubayd ibn Adi ibn Ghanm ibn Ka'b ibn Salima, the Ansari woman of Banu Salima

ibn Sa'd said: She was the wife of Yazid ibn Qayzi, who belonged to her clan. She accepted Islam and gave the pledge of allegiance.

names.arabic: أمامة بنت قرط بن خنساء بن سنان بن عبيد بن عدي بن غنم بن كعب بن سلمة
names.english: Umama bint Qurt ibn Khansa ibn Sinan ibn Ubayd ibn Adi ibn Ghanm ibn Ka'b ibn Salima

unresolved.explanation: “Qayzi” is a plausible consonant-compatible transliteration, but none of the supplied materials contains an exact vocalized Arabic witness for this name. Its vowels therefore remain uncertain.
